mapper.select: select a.*,p.product_name from zjudg_certificate_application a left join zjudg_certificate_product p on p.product_id=a.product_id order by a.create_time desc
select a.*,p.product_name from zjudg_certificate_application a left join zjudg_certificate_product p on p.product_id=a.product_id where a.application_id=#{id}
select a.*,p.product_name from zjudg_certificate_application a left join zjudg_certificate_product p on p.product_id=a.product_id where a.application_id=#{id} and a.user_id=#{userId}
mapper.update: update zjudg_certificate_application set status=#{toStatus},update_time=sysdate() where application_id=#{id} and status=#{fromStatus}
update zjudg_certificate_application set tracking_no=coalesce(#{trackingNo},tracking_no),status=#{status},update_time=sysdate() where application_id=#{id} and status=#{fromStatus}
